# Testing Library

> > Testing Library is a family of user-centric testing utilities for React, Vue, Angular, and other JavaScript frameworks, emphasizing testing software the way users interact with it.

Created by Kent C. Dodds, Testing Library provides DOM Testing Library as the foundation with framework-specific wrappers including React Testing Library, along with companion tools like user-event and jest-dom. The project promotes testing best practices that avoid implementation details and focus on accessibility.

## Key Topics

- DOM Testing Library
- React Testing Library
- user-event
- jest-dom
- Query methods (getBy, findBy, queryBy)
- User-centric testing philosophy
- Component testing
- Accessibility testing
- Angular Testing Library
- Vue Testing Library
- React Native Testing Library
- Jest integration
- TypeScript support
- Testing best practices
- Enzyme migration

- [Introduction | Testing Library](https://testing-library.com/docs): Core introduction to Testing Library philosophy and user-centric testing

- [Introduction | Testing Library](https://testing-library.com/docs/dom-testing-library/intro): DOM Testing Library introduction for maintainable Web UI testing
- [Install | Testing Library](https://testing-library.com/docs/dom-testing-library/install): Installation guide for DOM Testing Library and framework wrappers via npm
